thread:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Solari Converge pilot demo tomorrow morning. They need a temporary multi-region egress allowance + IP allowlist for the demo traffic. Can we accommodate a short throughput bump?
ben_platform: How much of a bump are they asking for?
maria_cs: They said ~2x their normal baseline. Current account default is 200 qps, asking for 400 qps to APAC and EU for about 48 hours. Also need three customer CIDRs whitelisted.
anya_sre: @ben_platform can you check peering capacity for EU edge (fra) and APAC? Ryan, FYI for observability/alerts.
ben_platform: I can make the limit change and add allowlist entries, but need exact CIDRs + precise window. Also will flag any region quota constraints.
maria_cs: CIDRs provided by Solari: 203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.0/25, 192.0.2.128/26. Requested window: start 2024-12-20T16:00Z end 2024-12-22T16:00Z. They also asked that Frankfurt (eu-central-1) egress be available.
ryan_eng: Frankfurt peering has two spare slots, but we need SRE to provision route and confirm BGP.
anya_sre: I'll open an authorization/change ticket and ensure we have rollback steps.
anya_sre: @deploy-bot create change request for account 927182 with the dates Maria gave.
deploy-bot: Change request #CR-4821 created by anya_sre for account 927182. Scheduled window 2024-12-20T16:00Z - 2024-12-22T16:00Z.
ben_platform: Plan to PATCH the account limits and add allowlist entries. Draft payload below:
```
PATCH /admin/accounts/927182/limits
{ "qps": 400, "regions": ["ap-southeast-1","eu-central-1"] }
```
ben_platform: Allowlist additions via console/infra: 203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.0/25, 192.0.2.128/26. Will annotate change with CR-4821.
ben_platform: Rolling change window now. Applying limit bump and CIDRs at 2024-12-20T16:02Z. Monitoring streams up.
anya_sre: Verified peering and egress routes for eu-central-1 are active. No packet loss on initial tests.
ryan_eng: Added temporary alert: token/sec > 500 -> paged to eng-oncall. Also added dashboard panel for Solari qps and error-rate.
maria_cs: Customer ran the demo successfully and reports latency within SLO. They asked that the allowlist auto-revoke after the window — please make sure revoke is scheduled.
ben_platform: Auto-revoke scheduled for 2024-12-22T16:05Z. I updated CR-4821 and closed the change.
maria_cs: Fantastic, thanks everyone :tada: Will capture feedback in the onboarding doc and close the enablement checklist.
ryan_eng: Note for runbook: if peering fills up, fallback to edge-proxy in ams until peering freed.
anya_sre: Logging the post-change verification in PagerDuty ticket and marking as completed.
maria_cs: Closing thread — great cross-team effort.
